title: PO1300 drops an uplifting anthem with "Good Days"
htmlContent: "Good Days," PO1300's latest single, is a reminder that at the heart of hip-hop, the stories of resilience still beat the strongest. PO1300 immediately sets a tone with verses guided more by story than form as they break through life's clutter like light poking through storm clouds. His delivery has an authenticity to it as it's classic and current. The song conjures the lyrical heft of Nas, the introspective punch of J. Cole, and the fiery resolve of Meek Mill, and it's a matter of PO1300 claiming his lane with a style that's confident yet compassionate. https://open.spotify.com/track/37nq7FOYzkYq5x0IyzD7uK The hook in "Good Days" is its mood escalator, providing a reprieve from the tension in the form of a soulful promise that better days, rather than just being dreamed of, are attainable. "Good Days" is an anthem for the self-made, hustling their way to a better day tomorrow. On the beat, you feel that East Coast bounce and soul, and then the lyrics smack home for anyone who was ever overlooked, who then came back even stronger. "PO1300 resurrects the spirit of grinding, turning pain to poetry and struggle to strength. With "Good Days," he confirms that, even at the bleakest moment, there's always light at the end of the verse. Follow PO1300 on Instagram
